name: VA Tech Wabag Ltd
title: VA Tech Wabag Ltd - 533269 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Order book INR 17,200 crore (over 4x revenue) and net cash ~INR 950 crore, but management guided only to 15–20% growth and 13–15% EBITDA with no new numbers; India-cluster margin slippage is glossed over.

triggers.label: Order book up 26% vs revenue 20%
triggers.quote: Year-over-year, our order backlog grew by 26%. When our revenue grew by 20%

triggers.label: Growth guardrail held at 15–20%
triggers.quote: we will grow at a 15% to 20%, continue to grow profitably. Our EBITDA margins will remain 13% to 15%.

triggers.label: India segment profit slide questioned
triggers.quote: The profits have come down from INR 127 crore to INR 60 crore in the last quarter.

guidance.quote: we will grow at a 15% to 20%, continue to grow profitably.
Our EBITDA margins will remain 13% to 15%.
our medium-term 3 to 5-year outlook is to take it to 20%
It's very imminent the one from Kuwait should happen I think next month. Within this quarter we can get that.

prior_guidance_check.quote: this year we did almost 20% on the higher side of the band
EBITDA 13% to 15%, we've firmly remained in that band
ROCE over 20% we are getting closer to that
O&M at 17% we said that our medium-term 3 to 5-year outlook is to take it to 20%

red_flags.label: India profit drop questioned
red_flags.quote: The profits have come down from INR 127 crore to INR 60 crore in the last quarter.

red_flags.label: Revenue flat year-on-year in India
red_flags.quote: it has been quite flat, not even a 5% growth year-on-year

red_flags.label: Price variation covers only 70% of costs
red_flags.quote: But still, it only covers 70% of our costs, not 100% of the cost.

evasions.quote: So look at blended margins and look at it multi-annually instead of for a quarter
Once we have the new strategy, obviously new guardrails will be drawn out
